roles_caveat: Original GMT-backbone seen TRAIN; previous labels already exposed. Roles fixed before new correspondence outputs, not unseen-backbone or blind GT testing.

cohort.selection: Use existing synchronous pure-positive error index; round-robin scenes then scene-qualified people then earliest eligible groups, spacing30 per person. Exclude already selected physical groups. No F-validity selection. Keep all actual primary queries and full legal reference provenance in every selected group, including unknown/no-sync failures.
cohort.local_selection: First round-robin scene/person error-pair representatives from frozen160, then earliest groups to fill32; fixed before feature outputs.

features.selection: Unique real patch centers only; deterministic row-major evenly spaced indices if >K. No descriptor/GT-based selection. No padding; complete patch must lie inside resized real image, center must lie in declared region. Continuous bbox edges use PixelMapping.A_edges; centers converted via validated A inverse.
features.zero_one_token: POINT_CORRESPONDENCE_UNAVAILABLE; retain ROI single-vector comparison, never report100% multipoint cycle

matching.normalize: FP32 per-token L2, explicit zero/nonfinite invalid
matching.note: Hard NN cycle equals mutual-return fraction algebraically, not an independent mechanism. Report this redundancy; soft cycle and one-to-one provide separate controls.
matching.primary_score: mutual cosine mean times min(two-side mutual coverage); no learned weights in frozen phase
matching.secondary_score: primary_score times soft cycle return; allvector components separately reported
matching.geometry: Reuse prior reliable F only as separate support on matched coordinates; absent/unreliable F is unknown, never excludes visual experiment. No new F/Pose sweep.

negative_controls.N1: Artificial same-timestamp wrong-partner duplication [A,A] and[B,B], preserve own real image and original first/second role for ROI being scored; duplicate physical camera is not a new camera, no geometry claim. Costs2 additional joint calls per pair.
negative_controls.N2: Same real pair and candidate membership, cyclically rotate reference proposal-to-region mapping in physical source order, independently of GT; singleton unchanged and disclosed.

local_crop.trigger: If >=25% selected original M0 target observations have <2 valid real centers, execute both224 and336 on fixed32-pair panel.
local_crop.crop: 1.5x native detector bbox, clipped original RGB crop, no saved rawimage copy. Independently encode each proposal crop, not fake physical cameras. Same crops224/336 and image budgets for DINO. LOCAL_CROP_VISUAL distinct from FULL_IMAGE_MULTIVIEW. More encoded patches do not mean more original detail.

gates.A: Engineering token/coordinate/parity passes AND positive-vs-knownnegative discrimination (paired perquery, all denominators), across>=2 fixed mechanism scenes and>=2 scene-qualified people; no random/cycle-only geometric claim.
gates.B: Complete all3 layers and all4 Fvariants, M0/M1/M2, oldVGGT/DINO and negative controls, plus required local scale panel before deciding. On mechanism scenes >=3 distinct known native row errors corrected, known corrections>harms, >=2scenes and>=2people; at least2 known corrections unique versus DINO,oldVGGT,F3; target-token evidence must exceed ring control; scene/person-cluster bootstrap1000 seed20261016 paired improvement lower95%bound>0 on common valid subset plus complete-coverage report. Otherwise NO_UNIQUE_OMEGA_CORRESPONDENCE_EVIDENCE or sample-insufficient.
gates.C: Only after usable independent evidence; original state forks and bounded logit residual abs<=1; genuine known final corrections>harms in>=2scenes/2people; otherwise NO_NATIVE_SOLVER_IDENTITY_GAIN.
gates.D: Only after trustworthy actual solver net benefit, full tracking and measured on-demand live inference; otherwise NOT_EXECUTED/NOT_MEASURED.

conditional_head.supervision: Fit scenes only, identity-aware listwise, mixed/unknown masked; matched native-only/DINO/oldVGGT heads on same rows; fixed optional margin. No DEV5/TEST tuning.

prohibited: use prior AG/QD/temporal-cycle as new method
